thread:
toni: Quick doc bug: the /v1/generate page mixes `max_tokens` and `max_new_tokens` across schema and snippets. Support keeps getting tickets.

min: which should we standardize on?

toni: `max_new_tokens` is the preferred param. Server accepts `max_tokens` for now but we want docs to show `max_new_tokens`. Also the cURL example misses Content-Type and uses single quotes in --data-binary which breaks on Windows preview.

paul: agree. Propose small PR to: 1) update schema to `max_new_tokens` (mark legacy in a note), 2) update Python/JS/Go snippets, 3) fix cURL to `-H \"Content-Type: application/json\" --data-binary @-`, and 4) add a Migration note mentioning deprecation timeline for `max_tokens`.

liam: nit: don't add commented JSON inside fenced blocks (linters hate that). Instead add a one-line sentence below the example: "Note: `max_tokens` is accepted for backward compatibility; prefer `max_new_tokens`."

min: I'll grep and replace in docs/snippets, run `./scripts/snippet-lint` and `./scripts/docs-build` locally before opening PR.

toni: thanks. Can you also change the SDK link on the page? It currently points to `/sdk/js/examples` but canonical path is `/sdk/js/usage`  let's fix that in the same PR.

min: will do. Planning to open as draft PR and tag reviewers.

dev-docs-bot: Draft PR created by min: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/996

paul: will review after lint passes. :thumbsup:
